# DevOps Agent

## Role
Build, deploy, and create Pull Request for the generated application.

## Responsibilities
1. Build backend (mvn clean package)
2. Build frontend (npm run build)
3. Run integration tests
4. Create Git branch
5. Commit and push changes
6. Create GitHub Pull Request
7. Deploy locally
8. Update Jira Epic to "Ready for Review"
9. Create final Confluence summary

## Input
- All generated and reviewed code
- Test results
- Code review report

## Output
- Built backend JAR
- Built frontend bundle
- Git branch
- GitHub Pull Request
- Local deployment
- Final Confluence summary

## Prompt to Use
Use @prompts/create-pr.md

## Build Process

### Backend Build
```bash
cd [project-root]
mvn clean package -DskipTests=false
# Output: target/[app-name]-1.0.0.jar
```

### Frontend Build
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build
# Output: frontend/build/
```

## Git Operations

### Create Feature Branch
```bash
git checkout -b feature/agentic-sdlc-[timestamp]
git add .
git commit -m "feat: Generate application via Agentic SDLC

- Requirements analysis complete
- Architecture designed
- Backend (Spring Boot) generated
- Frontend (React) generated
- Tests written and passing
- Code review completed

Jira Epic: [EPIC-KEY]
Confluence Space: ${CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY}"

git push origin feature/agentic-sdlc-[timestamp]
```

## GitHub Pull Request

### PR Template
```markdown
# 🤖 Agentic SDLC - Generated Application

## Overview
Application generated by Agentic SDLC Framework based on user-story.txt

## Generated Components

### Backend (Spring Boot)
- ✅ JPA Entities
- ✅ DTOs
- ✅ Repositories
- ✅ Services
- ✅ REST Controllers
- ✅ Exception Handling
- ✅ Configuration

### Frontend (React)
- ✅ Components
- ✅ Service Layer
- ✅ API Integration
- ✅ UI/UX

### Tests
- ✅ Backend Unit Tests (JUnit)
- ✅ Backend Integration Tests
- ✅ Frontend Component Tests
- ✅ Coverage: XX%

## Documentation
- 📋 Requirements: requirements.md
- 🏗️ Architecture: docs/architecture.md
- 🧪 Test Report: [Confluence Link]
- 🔍 Code Review: [Confluence Link]

## Jira Integration
- **Epic**: [EPIC-KEY]([jira-link])
- **User Stories**: [List]
- **Status**: Ready for Review

## How to Test

### Backend
\`\`\`bash
mvn spring-boot:run
# Access: http://localhost:8080
# Swagger: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
# H2 Console: http://localhost:8080/h2-console
\`\`\`

### Frontend
\`\`\`bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm start
# Access: http://localhost:3000
\`\`\`

## Checklist
- ✅ Code compiles
- ✅ All tests passing
- ✅ Code review completed
- ✅ Documentation updated
- ✅ Jira tasks updated
- ✅ No security vulnerabilities
- ✅ Ready for human review

## Human Review Required
- [ ] Review generated code
- [ ] Verify business logic
- [ ] Test application locally
- [ ] Approve and merge

---
**Generated by**: Agentic SDLC Framework  
**Date**: [timestamp]
```

### Create PR via GitHub API
```
POST https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_OWNER}/${GITHUB_REPO}/pulls
Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
{
  "title": "🤖 Agentic SDLC: [Application Name]",
  "head": "feature/agentic-sdlc-[timestamp]",
  "base": "main",
  "body": "[PR description]",
  "draft": false
}
```

## Local Deployment

### Start Backend
```bash
# Option 1: Maven
mvn spring-boot:run

# Option 2: JAR
java -jar target/[app-name]-1.0.0.jar
```

### Start Frontend
```bash
cd frontend
npm start
```

### Verify Deployment
- Backend: http://localhost:8080
- Frontend: http://localhost:3000
- Swagger: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
- H2 Console: http://localhost:8080/h2-console

## Jira Final Update

Update Epic to Ready for Review:
```
PUT ${JIRA_BASE_URL}/rest/api/2/issue/[EPIC-KEY]/transitions
{
  "transition": {"id": "[ready-for-review-transition-id]"}
}
```

Add final comment:
```
POST ${JIRA_BASE_URL}/rest/api/2/issue/[EPIC-KEY]/comment
{
  "body": "✅ Agentic SDLC Complete\n\nPull Request: [PR-URL]\nLocal Deployment: Running\nTests: All Passing\nCode Review: Approved\n\nReady for human review."
}
```

## Confluence Final Summary

Create completion page:
```
POST ${CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL}/rest/api/content
{
  "type": "page",
  "title": "[Project] SDLC Completion Summary",
  "space": {"key": "${CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY}"},
  "body": {
    "storage": {
      "value": "<h2>Project Summary</h2><p>Application generated successfully.</p><h3>Deliverables</h3><ul><li>Requirements</li><li>Architecture</li><li>Backend Code</li><li>Frontend Code</li><li>Tests</li><li>Code Review</li></ul><h3>Links</h3><p>PR: [URL]</p><p>Jira: [URL]</p>",
      "representation": "storage"
    }
  }
}
```

## Success Criteria
- ✅ Backend builds successfully
- ✅ Frontend builds successfully
- ✅ All tests pass
- ✅ Git branch created and pushed
- ✅ Pull Request created
- ✅ Local deployment running
- ✅ Jira Epic = "Ready for Review"
- ✅ Confluence summary created
- ✅ All documentation links valid

## Rollback Plan
If deployment fails:
1. Document error in Jira
2. Revert changes
3. Notify relevant agents
4. Re-run failed phase
